speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two shirts, and you have looked at them twice. The sermon was an hour and a half, which I call timely. A son who comes home inside the story is a better example than a play, and I am saying so with the quire in my hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He came home in the story. I am only going home in the bag.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the grey cloak going in, or does the sword stay out where a person can see it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sword rolls in the cloak. It is a lath. It has killed four Richmonds, and it will not kill a shirt.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Four is a player's count. Wrap it. My hand is full, so I shall ask while it is full. Does your wife know the plot of those forsworn gentlemen?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not yet.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Tell her mine opinion of it. Four young men swear off women and keep it till dinner. That I believe. She should have it from you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will tell her.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I heard them through the floor. They swore, and then they didn't. If anyone asks me I shall say I cannot read it, which is true and also convenient.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She will not ask you. You are not going. How far is Warwickshire? You have a ribbon in your fingers and the question is already in your mouth.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: How far is it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A hundred miles.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have never been ten. Hertfordshire was the far place, and this close is the other one. A hundred is a number for a letter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The children's things are wrapped each to itself. The sword, the ribbons, the riddle-book, the gloves. One knot would make the first minute a quarrel.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That is sense. I am surprised to be saying so with a quire still in my hand. The tables go in the bag. Brooke stays on the shelf. You are leaving him on purpose, I hope, and not because the cat has sat the decision.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On purpose. Brooke stays. He has had his names. He does not get a speech for the road.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And the big book, the one the cat prefers. If you take it, the shelf looks honest and the cat is furious.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Holinshed stays. Under a cloth. Against Gib. Master Field's book is not for a saddle.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Against Gib is a wish. He treats a cloth as a letter addressed to him. I will not promise the cloth stays flat. I will promise the book stays in the house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book stays. The sixty shillings stay in the canvas until tomorrow. The bay is not taken. I am not paying you over a bag.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Tomorrow is Lady Day. Tomorrow a Christian woman counts twenty shillings before noon. I am not counting them over ribbons. The firing sixpence runs through Tuesday and then stops. I am not starting it because you have a cloak in your hands.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I put the hose in? They are your mother's stitch. They have been on the chair since the carrier, and the chair has had enough of being looked at.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Put them in. They were meant to be worn at home. Home is the point of the bag.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The long page is still on the board, face down. I have not turned it. If it is going, you take it yourself. I do not carry another person's letter down my stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stays face down. It has no day in it. The four lines that had a day have already gone.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am not asking to read either page. I am asking whether the gift-knots are three or four, because my fingers are in the string.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four. The sword in the cloak. The ribbons. The riddle-book. The gloves. The shirts and the hose are mine, Alse. They are not gifts.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then tie the four, and carry the opinion I asked you to carry. The rest of your cleverness can stay out of my kitchen. As I am a Christian woman, the quarter is tomorrow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The opinion goes with me. The rest can wait until it is wanted.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: A hundred, and I have never been ten. I shall keep the ten.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go and write your list. Strike whatever reads as a performance. I am still holding the quire, and I am done asking.
